purpose: Record an independent visual source-image review of the official Marakwet East Form 34B final TOTAL row, read directly from the official IEBC portal PDF.

sample.review_context_note: Full official-page raster rendered at 200 DPI directly from a freshly downloaded, sha256-verified official IEBC Form 34B PDF (no third-party crop pipeline or CI artifact involved). This is a 3-page form; page 1 carries the FORM 34B header confirming CON 147 / MARAKWET EAST / county code 028, page 2 carries the final TOTAL row (shaded green), and page 3 carries the agent/returning-officer signature block. The PDF has no embedded text layer (confirmed by direct extraction attempt); the whole form is a scanned raster, so all values were read visually from the rendered page image and cross-confirmed with an independent 500 DPI crop of the shaded TOTAL row. The printed registered-voters total reconciles exactly to the existing governed 2022 denominator.

review.reviewed_by: Claude Sonnet 5 (Anthropic), acting as an independent Kenya Data Atlas contributor agent
review.independence_note: The official Form 34B PDF was downloaded fresh directly from forms.iebc.or.ke in this session (via the governed form_id = constituency_code + 277628 locator, after resetting the portal session from its default by-election context to the 2022 general election via index.php?r=common/set-election&id=5), its sha256 was computed from the downloaded bytes, and the TOTAL row integers were read directly from the rendered page image plus an independent 500 DPI crop of the same row. No OCR, machine-candidate pipeline, or prior extraction artifact was used or consulted before recording these values.
